title: acquire
description: Install inputs of the acquire addon. Platform facts come from the operator's zaentrum block and are not inputs.

url.title: Postgres URL
url.description: acquire's own Postgres database: postgres://user:password@host:5432/acquire?sslmode=require. acquire creates and migrates its tables on start.

serviceClientId.title: Service client id
serviceClientId.description: Confidential client (client credentials) acquire calls the download gateway and ingest with. The gateway accepts tokens from this client only.

clientId.title: Console client id
clientId.description: Public (PKCE) client of the standalone console login.

adminRole.title: Admin role
adminRole.description: Realm role that may grab, remove and configure.

apiKey.title: TMDB API key
apiKey.description: Server-side key for discovery search. Without it discovery is off.

key.title: Config key
key.description: 32 random bytes, base64. Encrypts every credential acquire stores (search source keys, download client passwords). Generated on first install when not given. Losing it means entering those credentials again.

previousKey.title: Previous config key
previousKey.description: The key before a rotation, so stored credentials keep opening until they are entered again. Remove it afterwards.

deny.title: Denied hosts
deny.description: Comma list of hostnames and domain suffixes acquire must never connect to, e.g. .other-namespace.svc,files.example.org.

allowInternal.title: Allow services in other namespaces
allowInternal.description: Allow search sources and download clients addressed as cluster services in other namespaces.

downloadsRoot.title: Downloads root
downloadsRoot.description: Where finished downloads are visible to acquire when a download client names no folder of its own. The platform media storage is mounted at /var/lib/katalog.

clients.title: Download clients
clients.description: Download clients the addon runs itself, each optional. acquire stores the enabled ones as managed clients, so they need no setup in its console. They work on the downloads claim, not on the media storage; acquire copies each finished download into the library and then releases it in its client.

downloads.title: Downloads volume
downloads.description: The claim acquire-downloads (ReadWriteOnce) both clients work on, each in a folder of its own, and acquire reads. A local volume pins the clients and acquire to its node.

volumeName.title: Volume
volumeName.description: A PV to bind by name. Under the operator leave it empty: it refuses a claim that names its volume, and a PV whose claimRef names acquire-downloads binds without it.

reserve.title: Reserve
reserve.description: Kept free on the volume: NZBGet pauses below it, and acquire hands no release to a client that would leave less. Empty: a tenth of the size.

tolerations.title: Tolerations
tolerations.description: The taints of the volume's node, which acquire and both clients tolerate (and no other pod of the chart): a local volume pins them to that node.

vpn.title: Through the platform VPN
vpn.description: Torrents, peers, trackers and name lookups go through the platform VPN's SOCKS5 proxy, and the pod reaches nothing outside the cluster directly. Needs a platform with a VPN; turn it off to run qBittorrent without one.

username.title: Username
username.description: The Web UI and API login acquire uses.

password.title: Password
password.description: The Web UI and API password. Generated on first install when not given.

seeding.title: Seeding goal
seeding.description: A finished torrent seeds until it reaches the ratio or has seeded the minutes, whichever comes first; then acquire removes it with its data. -1 lifts a limit.

vpn.title: Through the platform VPN
vpn.description: Must stay off: NZBGet has no SOCKS5 proxy setting, so its news server connections cannot go through the platform VPN.

password.title: Password
password.description: The control password. Generated on first install when not given.
